title: Customer contract terms and billing schedules versus invoices and payments
prompt: Compare customer contract terms and billing schedules to actual invoices and payments. Identify missing, duplicate or incorrectly timed billings.
steps: read the contracts and billing schedules: Dime's contracts first, then a document request for contracts kept outside Dime
pull the period's invoices and payments by customer
run schedule_vs_actual: each scheduled billing against the invoices raised, by customer, amount and expected date
list missing billings, duplicate invoices for one schedule line and invoices raised outside the schedule window; match payments to invoices and list unapplied payments
write the workbook with the contract line and invoice id on every exception

done.text: Every exception row cites the customer id, the contract line and the invoice id where one exists
contract-billing-exceptions.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Missing, duplicate and incorrectly timed billings are separate exception types; usage-based and milestone billings are judged against their trigger, not a calendar date
